content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a compatibility issue between the new TokenStream API and older analyzers that did not properly handle the state of tokens, particularly with respect to the management of token attributes and payloads. The original implementation did not correctly clone the payloads of tokens when transitioning between the old and new APIs, leading to potential data corruption or unexpected behavior when tokens were reused. The patch addresses this by ensuring that payloads are cloned appropriately, maintaining the integrity of token data across different API usages.
